items.title: Scientists discover why snake embryos twist into spirals

items.title: A “quantum bath” puts quantum entanglement on autopilot
items.summary_raw: Physicists have demonstrated a new way to entangle distant quantum bits without the constant measurements and active control normally required. The experiment confirms a theoretical prediction made more than 20 years ago and could offer a simpler way to connect modules in future quantum computers.
